title: A FEAST FOR TROLLS: ENGAGEMENT ANALYSIS OF COUNTERNARRATIVES AGAINST ONLINE TOXICITY

bias_targets.methodology: Automated AI detection tracking the 'RACISM' label across millions of multilingual social media messages, and qualitative analysis of reported toxic content.
Automated AI detection tracking the 'SEXISM' label across millions of multilingual social media messages, alongside qualitative analysis identifying misogyny.
Qualitative analysis of English toxic messages to identify Islamophobia, and the manual tracking and reporting of anti-Semitic (e.g., neo-Nazi, holocaust denial) accounts.
Tracking and frequency analysis of homophobic slurs (e.g., 'faggot') using an AI-driven toxic keyword search algorithm.
Qualitative analysis of a sample of 1,000 English toxic messages to identify instances of fat-shaming.
